title: Printed number lines for time
subject: Mathematics
source: Seeded from mathematics/y4 lesson 79 (Printed number lines for time)
intro: Lesson 79: Durations in hours and minutes. To understand how to find durations that cross the hour and midday

blocks.text: Each small step is 15 minutes. Mark the start time, jump to the next hour, then whole hours, then the minutes left.

questions.a: 1 h 35 min; 1 h 20 min; 2 h 40 min
questions.model: Teacher: 7:15 to 8:15 is 1 hour, then 35 min.

questions.q: A cake needs 1 hour 25 minutes. It goes in at 4:50 p.m. When is it ready?
A film ends at 7:05 p.m. and lasts 1 h 50 min. When did it start?
1:15 p.m. to 2:45 p.m.? A) 1 h 30 min B) 1 h 15 min C) 2 h 30 min
Big question: how long from 10:45 a.m. to 1:20 p.m.?
